import requests

def get_common_words():
    url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dwyl/english-words/master/words_alpha.txt'
    response = requests.get(url)
    words = set(w.strip().upper() for w in response.text.split() if len(w.strip()) == 5)
    return words

def get_ladder(start, end, word_list):
    queue = collections.deque([(start, [start])])
    visited = {start}
    while queue:
        curr, path = queue.popleft()
        if curr == end: return path
        for i in range(5):
            for c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ':
                nxt = curr[:i] + c + curr[i+1:]
                if nxt in word_list and nxt not in visited:
                    visited.add(nxt)
                    queue.append((nxt, path + [nxt]))
    return None

words = get_common_words()
# Manually adding some common words if they are missing
words.update(['GLOBE', 'GLOVE', 'GLOVE', 'PROBE', 'PRONE', 'PHONE', 'PHASE', 'PAUSE', 'PULSE'])
path = get_ladder('GLOBE', 'PULSE', words)
print(path)"}
